titulo_es: Describe symptoms with duration and frequency

texto: Describe duration and frequency of symptoms; check how and when to follow an instruction.

bloques.pregunta: Listen to the explanation and select the correct indication or duration.
bloques.audio: Έχω βήχα εδώ και τρεις ημέρες και κοιμάμαι άσχημα τη νύχτα. Μπορείτε να μου εξηγήσετε πότε πρέπει να πάρω αυτό το φάρμακο; Πάρτε το χάπι μετά το φαγητό και πιείτε αρκετό νερό.

opciones.texto: I've had a cough for three days and I sleep bad at night.
opciones.explicacion: Identify the information expressed in the audio.

opciones.texto: Can you explain when I should take this medicine?
opciones.explicacion: The audio does not present that data.

opciones.texto: I want to return the shirt because the size doesn't suit me.

frases.en: Take the pill after eating and drink enough water.
